name: anvil-edit-development
description: Review and planning skills for building Anvil Edit without weakening its evidence, privacy, or editor contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Build predictive editing with explicit evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Repository-local workflows for auditing editor adapters, reviewing prediction and privacy contracts, designing staged evaluations, and admitting model candidates as discovery rather than local qualification.
defaultPrompt: Audit an editor adapter against the Anvil Edit contract.
Review a prediction or trace-privacy contract change.
